versions.description_html:
Copilot in Power Automate isn't the tool most beginners think it is. You don't have to build flows by hand or write any code before it starts helping you.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Copilot in Power Automate Really Is
  • How You Talk to It and What Happens Next
  • One Real Beginner Task From a Blank Page to a Working Flow
  • The Other Half, Copilot That Reads Your Automation for You
  • What Copilot Can't Do Yet
  • The Prompts That Waste Your Time
  • Where It Fits in Microsoft 365 and Azure
  • The Short Recap and One Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
